ingredients.name: Wolfsbane
ingredients.description: A bitter purple herb used in protective and lycanthrope-warding brews.

ingredients.name: Nightshade
ingredients.description: Glossy black berries; the base of most sleeping draughts and half the poisons.

ingredients.name: Sunblossom
ingredients.description: A yellow flower that only opens at dawn. Central to healing potions.

ingredients.name: Frostcap Mushroom
ingredients.description: A pale fungus that stays cold to the touch even in summer.

ingredients.name: Emberroot
ingredients.description: A root that smoulders when crushed, used in fire resistance tonics.

ingredients.name: Silverleaf
ingredients.description: A metallic-sheened leaf prized for antivenoms.

ingredients.name: Giant Spider Venom
ingredients.description: Milked from live spiders, which is exactly as dangerous as it sounds.

ingredients.name: Basilisk Eye
ingredients.description: Rare and expensive; a key reagent in petrification cures.

ingredients.name: Troll Fat
ingredients.description: Rendered from a troll, it carries a faint regenerative property.

ingredients.name: Mandrake Root
ingredients.description: Screams when pulled. Used in restoration and curse-breaking.

ingredients.name: Gravebloom
ingredients.description: A grey flower that grows only over buried remains; used in necrotic wards.

ingredients.name: Kingsfoil
ingredients.description: An unremarkable weed to the untrained eye, and a potent healing herb to everyone else.

ingredients.name: Phoenix Ash
ingredients.description: Warm ash that never quite goes out. The heart of any revival brew.

ingredients.name: Moonpetal
ingredients.description: Blooms only under a full moon; used in divination and scrying draughts.

ingredients.name: Cave Lichen
ingredients.description: A faintly glowing lichen used in light and darkvision preparations.

ingredients.name: Dragon Scale Powder
ingredients.description: Ground scale that lends elemental resistance to a mixture.

ingredients.name: Harpy Feather
ingredients.description: Used in charm-related brews and, less legally, in love philtres.

ingredients.name: Bogwater Salt
ingredients.description: Crusted salt from a swamp's edge; a cheap but effective preservative.

ingredients.name: Ironbark Shavings
ingredients.description: Shavings from a treant-touched oak, used in armor-hardening oils.

ingredients.name: Wyvern Sting
ingredients.description: The intact venom sac of a wyvern, worth a small fortune intact.

ingredients.name: Mind Reaver Brine
ingredients.description: Preserving fluid from a mind reaver specimen; used in psychic wards.

ingredients.name: Ghost Mushroom
ingredients.description: A translucent fungus from haunted ground, used in invisibility oils.

ingredients.name: Blood Lotus
ingredients.description: A crimson water-flower; addictive, potent, and banned in three cities.

ingredients.name: Purified Water
ingredients.description: Thrice-filtered and blessed. The neutral base of nearly every recipe.
